channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Karur stampede case: TVK leader Vijay to face second round of CBI questioning in Delhi today
item.description: Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) leader Vijay has been summoned to appear before the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) again in New Delhi on Monday regarding the investigation into the Karur stampede.

item.title: Congress Breathes New Life into Medaram Jathara, CM Revant Reddy Takes Cabinet to Tribal Heartland
item.description: Held once every two years in Medaram village of Mulugu district, the four-day festival honours the tribal goddesses Sammakka and Saralamma and draws tens of millions of devotees from Telangana and across the country.

item.title: BJP criticises CM Revanth Reddy over enrolling for leadership programme at Harvard
item.description: The Telangana BJP on Monday criticised Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy's decision to travel to the United States to attend what it termed a "crash leadership course", questioning the timing and financial prudence of the move.

item.title: Brazilian President criticises US action in Venezuela
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva criticised recent US military action in Venezuelan territory, warning that unilateral use of force erodes international law and threatens global stability.

item.title: Death toll rises to 14 in Pakistan shopping mall fire, over 70 still missing
item.description: The death toll in the Gul Plaza shopping mall fire in Pakistan's Karachi climbed to 14 on Monday after the rescuers found eight more bodies from the site, local media reported.

item.title: Isha Malviya: Film ‘Ishqa’n De Lekhe’ means more to me than words can express
item.description: Television actress Isha Malviya, who is all set to be seen on the big screen with her maiden Punjabi romantic drama “Ishqa’n De Lekhe”, says the film means more to her than words can express.

item.title: Bengal SIR: Controversies over summoning celebrities baseless, says ECI
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) on Monday asserted that controversies over the summoning of celebrities and the who's who for hearings on claims and objections on the draft voters' list are baseless.

item.title: Seven arrested for gang-rape of teenage girl in Bengal’s Purulia
item.description: Seven people have been arrested in connection with the abduction and gang-rape of a teenage girl in West Bengal's Purulia district, senior police officers said on Monday.

item.title: Ahan Shetty enjoyed ‘Border 2’ shoot with Diljit Dosanjh, recalls next day ‘soreness’
item.description: Actor Ahan Shetty talked about having the best time shooting a scene with Diljit Dosanjh in the upcoming war drama “Border 2” but admitted that the soreness the next day wasn’t so great.

item.title: ECI to host IICDEM 2026 in Delhi, over 100 delegates from 70 nations to participate
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) is set to host the India International Conference on Democracy and Election Management (IICDEM) 2026, starting January 21 at the Bharat Mandapam in the national capital.
